title.zh: 将苏禄省 Jolo市镇 Jolo 中央小学的名称变更为Mohammad Tulawie 中央小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Jolo Central Elementary School in the Municipality of Jolo, Province of Sulu, to Mohammad Tulawie Central Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Jolo Central Elementary School in the Municipality of Jolo, Province of Sulu, to Mohammad Tulawie Central Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Jolo Central tại Thị trấn Jolo, Tỉnh Sulu thành Trường tiểu học Mohammad Tulawie Central
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Jolo Central ในเทศบาล Jolo, จังหวัด Sulu เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Mohammad Tulawie Central
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Jolo Central di Kotamadya Jolo, Provinsi Sulu menjadi Sekolah Dasar Mohammad Tulawie Central
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Jolo Central di Perbandaran Jolo, Wilayah Sulu menjadi Sekolah Rendah Mohammad Tulawie Central

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1962/ra_3511_1962.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Jolo Central Elementary School in the Municipality of Jolo, Province of Sulu, is changed to Mohammad Tulawie Central Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1962.
